correctness.rationale: Exact conjugation on labelled matrix units recovers supports and base bijection, then forces one global central multiplier. The resulting free central action produces each rank count. The self-inverse equation reduces to an involutive permutation and a single central square value; disjoint transpositions and fixed points give the full sum. An explicit multiplication-table checker validates ranks and self-inverse counts for six finite groups at n=1,2,3; selected cases also compare actual conjugation functions. These checks do not replace the general proof.

originality.rationale: The general central-congruence quotient, unlabelled symmetric inverse monoid, and underlying wreath-group machinery are acknowledged as prior results. The claimed novel step is the explicit labelled-rook congruence fiber combined with the complete central-square-root involution enumerator and the two-torsion separation. Targeted prior-statement comparisons found no covering formula, subject to the specific older-literature risk below.
residual_risks: The quotient may have been enumerated earlier under a projective/central rook-wreath or wreath-group-involution terminology not indexed in the searches.
The Kundu–Mondal and Houghton full texts were not read; their scope is dissimilar in the accessible abstracts, but deeper overlapping formulas cannot be excluded solely from snippets.
Same-model mathematics review is not an independent audit.

value.rationale: The explicit full-group and all-rank invariant measures how inner partial conjugation retains central-square information. The C4 versus C2^2 comparison demonstrates a mathematically motivated distinction invisible to all rank counts; it is not an arbitrary slice or mere restatement of the general quotient theorem. Both nonabelian and abelian central-square distributions are covered.
